demonstrates:
with 4000 graph nodes and their edges and assertions spread across 200 cases, and ANALYZE run: the live-graph read for a selective case used a case index, assertions-by-edge used graph_assertions_edge_idx, and nodes-by-case used graph_nodes_case_idx. The dominant-case plan is recorded for comparison. No latency or throughput claim is made. Plans:

        Filter: (organisation_id = '2b409005-b008-402e-86f2-0ed1f2b9bd47'::uuid)",
